import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for source CSVs
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_8/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_8/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_8/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0
    # Note: Source 0 has columns ['track_id', 'dummy'] but may contain an extra unnamed index column
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    # Drop any unnamed columns (like 'Unnamed: 0') that come from saved indices
    df0 = df0.loc[:, ~df0.columns.str.contains('^Unnamed')]
    # Confirm columns are exactly ['track_id', 'dummy']
    assert set(df0.columns) == {'track_id', 'dummy'}, f"Unexpected columns in Source0: {df0.columns.tolist()}"

    # Load Source 1
    # Source 1 has columns ['index_track', 'track_id'] but may contain an extra unnamed index column
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    df1 = df1.loc[:, ~df1.columns.str.contains('^Unnamed')]
    # Confirm columns are exactly ['index_track', 'track_id']
    assert set(df1.columns) == {'index_track', 'track_id'}, f"Unexpected columns in Source1: {df1.columns.tolist()}"

    # Transformation plan:
    # Target schema: ['index_track': int, 'track_id': int, 'dummy': int]
    #
    # Source0 has 'track_id' and 'dummy'
    # Source1 has 'index_track' and 'track_id'
    #
    # We want to combine these two sources to get all three columns.
    #
    # Join condition:
    # - Both have 'track_id' column.
    # - Join on 'track_id' to bring 'dummy' from Source0 and 'index_track' from Source1 together.
    #
    # After join, keep columns ['index_track', 'track_id', 'dummy'].
    #
    # Since both sources have many rows, and track_id may not be unique in either,
    # we do an inner join on 'track_id' to get matching rows.
    #
    # Finally, ensure data types are integer as per target schema.

    # Perform inner join on 'track_id'
    df_merged = pd.merge(df1, df0, on='track_id', how='inner')

    # Select and reorder columns to match target schema
    df_target = df_merged[['index_track', 'track_id', 'dummy']]

    # Convert columns to integer type (if not already)
    df_target['index_track'] = df_target['index_track'].astype(int)
    df_target['track_id'] = df_target['track_id'].astype(int)
    df_target['dummy'] = df_target['dummy'].astype(int)

    # Save to target CSV without index column
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
